Forward ordinary MAP is the recommended starting route, not an implicit
selection of the matched piecewise-constant feedback example. D002/D003 must
return the exact projector, sample association, normalization and path support.
No historical JINC source/default or comparison outcome becomes an ordinary-MAP
method rule. JINC specialization is deferred.

The owner may approve the recommended scope and paper-only closure direction
as a bundle, with exceptions named by ID. That disposition would resolve these
preparation choices only. It would not fill an absent numerical field or grant
all future upstream permissions. Subsequent complete method approval must bind
actual Pi/F/B, operation graph, grouping, support, learning, stopping/resources,
terminal selection and failure behavior, plus the exact upstream records.

No answer is requested here about reinterpreting frozen generic science. If
closure reveals a contradiction with it, propose an explicit successor for
separate review and preserve r0.4.

## Later gates preserved

After paper definition: exact scientific-method and upstream owner approval;
separately authorized implementation assessment; separately scoped numerical
experiments and qualification. The ordinary numerical-method authorship gates
remain in force; the generic-core program-order exception is not extended.

Any later experiment must predeclare its hypothesis, causal information
boundary, action/control, population, independent pointing, source recovery,
morphology, residual leakage, support, convergence/stopping, runtime and memory
metrics, protections and stopping/disposition rules. Empirical policy requires
independent-pointing replication. This ledger neither chooses nor runs that
experiment. Existing reductions and failed attempts remain preserved.
